question: What is the ratio of molecules with at least one double bond to those with at least one single bond among all molecules?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

question: Find the most common k_symbol used in transactions involving accounts from the 'West Bohemia' district.

question: Find the total number of votes cast by each user, grouped by their reputation level.

question: Calculate the average transaction amount for each quarter of the year.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM T2.date) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1' WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM T2.date) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM T2.date) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS quarter, AVG(T2.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM trans AS T2 GROUP BY quarter

question: What is the percentage of molecules with more than 10 atoms that contain both oxygen and nitrogen atoms?
sql: WITH large_molecules AS (SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id GROUP BY T1.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(T2.atom_id) > 10), oxygen_and_nitrogen AS (SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM large_molecules AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.element IN ('o', 'n') GROUP BY T1.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.element) = 2) SELECT CAST(COUNT(oxygen_and_nitrogen.molecule_id) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(large_molecules.molecule_id) AS percentage_oxygen_and_nitrogen FROM large_molecules LEFT JOIN oxygen_and_nitrogen ON large_molecules.molecule_id = oxygen_and_nitrogen.molecule_id

question: What percentage of all atoms are hydrogen atoms?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM atom AS T1

question: Find the molecule with the second-highest number of unique atoms connected to its bonds.
sql: SELECT T1.molecule_id, T1.label FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id GROUP BY T1.molecule_id, T1.label ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T3.atom_id) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

question: Find all bonds within the molecule labeled '+'.
sql: SELECT T2.bond_id, T2.bond_type FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '+'

question: How many molecules labeled '+' contain a fluorine atom?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+' AND T1.element = 'f'

question: Which molecule has the highest ratio of oxygen atoms to total atoms?
sql: WITH oxygen_count AS (SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS oxygen_num FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.element = 'o' GROUP BY T1.molecule_id), total_atoms AS (SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS total_num FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id GROUP BY T1.molecule_id) SELECT oxygen_count.molecule_id, CAST(oxygen_count.oxygen_num AS FLOAT) * 100 / total_atoms.total_num AS oxygen_ratio FROM oxygen_count, total_atoms ORDER BY oxygen_ratio DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many distinct users have interacted with posts linked by 'Related Posts' feature?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT userid) FROM postlinks AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.id

question: How many different banks are involved in transactions on account number 789?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bank) FROM trans WHERE account_id = 789

question: What was the total reputation gained by users who posted questions?
sql: SELECT SUM(T1.reputation) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.owneruserid WHERE T2.posttypeid = 1

question: Who are the top 3 users with the most reputation points?
sql: SELECT DisplayName, Reputation FROM users ORDER BY Reputation DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many different elements are present in molecule TR005?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT element) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR005'

question: Calculate the total number of unique atoms across all molecules that contain only double bonds.
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T3.atom_id) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id INNER JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '='

question: Which district has the highest total transaction volume?
sql: SELECT T1.district_id, SUM(T2.amount) AS total_volume FROM district AS T1 JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.account_id GROUP BY T1.district_id ORDER BY total_volume DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the ratio of clients who have issued cards to those who haven't?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.disp_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM disp AS T1 LEFT JOIN card AS T2 ON T1.disp_id = T2.disp_id

question: What percentage of bonds in molecule 'TR000' are double bonds?
sql: WITH total_bonds AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'), double_bonds AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' AND bond_type = '=') SELECT CAST(double_bonds.count AS FLOAT) * 100 / total_bonds.total AS percentage_double_bonds FROM double_bonds, total_bonds

question: What is the ratio of transactions with a negative balance compared to those with a positive balance?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.balance < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.balance >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_positive_ratio FROM trans AS T1

question: How many users have a profile picture URL starting with 'https://www.gravatar.com/avatar/'?
sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM users WHERE profileimageurl LIKE 'https://www.gravatar.com/avatar/%'

question: What is the total number of atoms in the molecule labeled '+'?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_atoms FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

question: What is the total number of votes cast on posts by users who have more than 1000 reputation points?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.userid = T2.id

question: List all molecules that contain at least one carbon atom.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'c'

question: Find the average amount paid on loans for each district.
sql: SELECT AVG(T1.amount), T2.a2 FROM loan AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.district_id GROUP BY T2.a2

question: List the top 3 districts with the highest total loan amounts.
sql: SELECT T2.a2, SUM(T3.amount) as total_loan_amount FROM loan AS T3 INNER JOIN account AS T1 ON T3.account_id = T1.account_id INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id GROUP BY T2.a2 ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Calculate the total score of all comments that were upvoted by users who have more than 1000 reputation points.
sql: SELECT SUM(T1.score) FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.postid INNER JOIN users AS T3 ON T2.userid = T3.id WHERE T2.votetypeid = 2 AND T3.reputation > 1000

question: What percentage of posts were created in the year 2013?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creaiondate) = 2013 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM posts

question: How many users have both more than 500 upvotes and more than 2000 views?
sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM users WHERE reputation > 2000 AND views > 1000
